tool.title: Text on the picture
tool.draftHint: Changes are kept as a draft. «Save» puts the picture with the words into the chat.
tool.saved: Saved. The picture with the words is now a new message in the chat.

verticals.top: At the top of the box
verticals.middle: In the middle of the box
verticals.bottom: At the bottom of the box

words.title: Words on the picture
words.empty: No words yet. Add a headline, a main text or an accent below, or let the model write them.
words.lockedHint: The model will not change these words when it writes or rewrites.

placeholder.headline: A short headline
placeholder.accent: A price, a date, a call to action

place.title: Put the words on the picture
place.hint: Each block of words gets its own box on the picture. Free: boxes you already have, then the picture's text map from its style, then the bottom third.
place.unplaced: {n} block has no box yet | {n} blocks have no box yet
place.vision: Let the model look at the picture
place.visionHint: Paid. The model gets a small copy of the picture and finds calm places for the words, away from faces and objects.
place.replace: Move boxes that are already there
place.replaceHint: Off: only blocks without a box get one. On: every box is placed again.

sources.layer: {n} kept where it was | {n} kept where they were
sources.zone: {n} by the style's text map | {n} by the style's text map
sources.vision: {n} by the model | {n} by the model
sources.fallback: {n} at the bottom | {n} at the bottom

place.visionFailed: The model did not answer; the words went to the free places.

preview.title: What goes to Google
preview.hint: Word for word. Nothing is sent from this window.
preview.nothing: Nothing will be sent to Google with these settings: this step is free.
preview.pictures: {n} picture to draw | {n} pictures to draw
preview.blocks: {n} block of words | {n} blocks of words

write.title: Write the words
write.hint: The model writes all the blocks at once. Blocks marked «Keep» stay as they are.
write.useTone: Use the brand kit's tone of voice
write.useNeighbours: Use the words of the other frames of this work
write.notePlaceholder: For example: a spring sale, minus 20% on everything until Sunday
write.needBlocks: Add at least one block of words first: the model fills the blocks you have.

variants.title: Variants of one line
variants.hint: A few versions of one line to pick from. Each variant is a separate request.
variants.noBlock: No block, just show the variants
variants.note: The line or what it is about
variants.notePlaceholder: Type the line to rework, or what it should say
variants.useSystem: Use the instructions for picture words
variants.useTone: Use the brand kit's tone of voice
variants.feedback: What to change compared with last time
variants.feedbackPlaceholder: For example: shorter, without the word «best»
variants.needSomething: Type a line or turn on at least one switch.
variants.pickBlock: Pick a block above to put a variant into it
variants.done: The variant is in the block

humanize.title: Make it sound human
humanize.hint: The model rewrites the words so they read like a person wrote them, not a robot. Blocks marked «Keep» stay as they are.
humanize.nothing: There is nothing to rewrite: the blocks are empty or kept.
humanize.same: The model left the words as they were.

kit.title: Brand kit
kit.hint: Fonts, logos and colors come from the brand kit.

fonts.defaultHint: New text layers get this font. You can change it for each layer.
fonts.google: Add a font from Google Fonts
fonts.needKit: Pick a brand kit first: the font is added to it.

layouts.title: Ready layouts
layouts.hint: A layout puts boxes for the words, a logo and shapes in one click. The words stay yours.
layouts.save: Save the current layers as a layout
layouts.replaceAsk: The layout will replace the layers you have now. Go on?

layers.title: Layers
layers.noLogos: The brand kit has no logos
layers.empty: No layers yet. Use «Put the words», a layout, or the buttons above.

props.title: Layer settings
props.scrimHint: The plate makes light words readable on a busy picture.
props.pick: Click a layer on the picture or in the list to change it.

generate.title: New background
generate.hint: Draw a new picture to put the words on. The words and layers stay where they are. You can close the window while it draws.
generate.placeholder: Describe the background: what is on it, the light, the colors
generate.noLetteringHint: Asks the model not to draw any letters, so your words are the only ones.
generate.useCurrent: Base it on the current picture
generate.useCurrentHint: The model gets the current background and changes it as described.
generate.stopAsk: Stop drawing? Backgrounds that are already done stay.
generate.running: Drawing… You can keep working or close the window.

google.title: Fonts from Google Fonts
google.hint: The list is kept in the app. «Add» downloads one font file from Google into the brand kit; then it works on pictures.
google.addedToast: Font «{family}» added to the brand kit

report.fallback: Some letters are not in the font and were drawn with {font}: {chars}
report.missing: These letters are in no font and were left out: {chars}
report.clipped: {n} block of words does not fit its box. Make the box bigger or the letters smaller. | {n} blocks of words do not fit their boxes. Make the boxes bigger or the letters smaller.
report.missingFiles: {n} file (a font or a logo) is gone and was skipped. | {n} files (fonts or logos) are gone and were skipped.

errors.bad_image: The background does not open as a picture.
errors.bad_layer: One of the layers is broken. Delete it and add it again.
errors.builtin_layout: A ready layout that comes with the app cannot be deleted.
errors.busy: New backgrounds are still drawing. Wait or press «Stop».
errors.empty_layout: There are no layers to keep as a layout.
errors.font_download_failed: Could not download the font from Google Fonts. Try again later.
errors.font_in_kit: The font «{family}» is already in the brand kit.
errors.fonts_unreachable: Google Fonts cannot be reached. Check the internet connection.
errors.font_unreadable: The font file does not open.
errors.no_picture: There is no picture to put words on.
errors.not_an_image: This file is not a picture.
errors.not_ready: The picture is not ready yet.
errors.placement_empty: The model did not say where to put the words.
errors.text_empty: The model returned no words. Try again or change the request.
errors.too_long: Too many words for one rewrite (more than {max} characters). Rewrite fewer blocks at a time.
errors.too_many_layouts: Too many layouts of your own: up to {max}. Delete one you do not need.
errors.too_many_texts: Too many blocks of words: up to {max}.
